text:
maya: CI alert — image push failing on canary when finalizing manifest. `docker push registry.redwood/inference/canary:sha123` -> blob upload 403 for one layer. Anyone else seeing this?
sam: same on ubuntu-22 runners. rerun didn't help.
ci-bot: build #4521 failed during push: registry returned 403 on chunked upload. https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4521
liam: did we rotate the registry service account creds yesterday?
maya: yes we rotated keys, but most pushes are fine — looks intermittent. logs show `Signature expired` on one PUT.
jen: PR #678 changed a multi-stage `COPY --chown=` earlier which changed layer order; could that affect presign flow? unsure.
sam: quick triage: try `--no-cache` or `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0` to see if cache/path is related.
maya: ran `buildx build --push --no-cache` — different failure: `manifest invalid` on finalization.
infra-bot: note: registry token rotation completed at 1789850000 UTC. Watch for presign TTL issues.
liam: request bisect — can someone rerun with verbose logs: `--progress=plain` and `BUILDKIT_STEP_LOG=1`, paste last 200 lines. Also try pushing to staging registry to isolate.
maya: pasted logs:
```
POST /v2/inference/canary/blobs/uploads/ HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
PUT /v2/inference/canary/blobs/uploads/abcd1234 403 Forbidden
{"errors":[{"code":"UNAUTHORIZED","message":"Signature expired"}]}
```
sam: signature expired → presigned URL TTL or worker clock skew. Any builders with bad time?
jen: `build-ub22-7` had clock drift ~5m earlier today per node-monitor.
maya: i can repro from my laptop and push succeeds, so it's worker-specific.
liam: infra action: will sweep builders, check `chronyd`/`ntpd`, and restart `buildkitd` where drift > 30s. tagging @infra-bot to run a heatmap.
ci-bot: re-run triggered by sam: build #4522
liam: restarted buildkit on two affected nodes and corrected time sync on three. monitoring.
maya: re-run on the same node after restart succeeded. marking as resolved for now.
jen: follow-ups: add build-fleet healthcheck to fail if `date -u` drift > 30s before starting push; add a line to runbook for presign TTL checks.
maya: creating follow-up issue: https://redwood.example/issues/INFRA-912
sam: nice triage — thanks all :thumbsup:
